items.title: Publish the declared plan page (D1 with D9)
items.what: When .common-rules.json declares plan_page, the published page is the project's own generated page, not the tracker page. `tracker published --page <path>` records that file and the ledger's digest; the card compares the ledger digest for a declared page (a generator that stamps today's date would otherwise report a change every day) and the page digest for the tracker page. A declared plan_page without --page refuses, naming it.
items.done: On an app-shaped scratch project with plan_page declared: published without --page refuses; with --page it records page, the page's digest and ledger_digest; the card stays silent while only the generated date changes and speaks when the ledger moves; the tracker-page flow is unchanged.

log.by: session PhotoVault App (cross-session message; at = arrival)
log.evidence: On first real use, `tracker published docs/proposals/70-r9-delivery-plan.json --url …` recorded the digest of the tracker render page (49,729 bytes), but the sponsor's artifact is published from the declared plan_page, `python3 tools/build_plan.py` → docs/proposals/70-r9-delivery-plan.html (254,111 bytes). The record claimed a publish that never happened. The app removed the sidecar; its warmup --check is still ready. It suggested --page, or deriving the page from plan_page.

A gap in D1 with D9: the V-09 review had noted D9's project page generator as unimplemented. The lead checked that the app's build_plan.py writes date.today() into its page, so a page-file digest would report a change daily; for a declared page, the card compares the ledger digest. c4bcbcf on p20-v11. With plan_page declared, --page is required; the page must be inside the project, a regular file, tracked and committed (git pathspecs literal). The sidecar gains page and ledger_digest; the card compares ledger_digest for a page record, so a generated date alone is silent. SKILL.md and lead-prompt name the plan_page order. Fixed along the way: the sidecar write crashed when docs/proposals/tracker/ did not exist. Red 43 failures, then green; 754 OK. Flagged: page freshness not checked; any declaration problem blocks recording; bin/tracker help lacks --page; a symlinked tracker dir would write the sidecar outside the project.
probes: the date-stamping generator end to end, including with derecord's hook; refusals; rulings asked on declaration-problem scope, page freshness and the symlinked tracker dir

Passed: every refusal (17 cases, nothing written), the date-stamping flow end to end, derecord's hook without interference, card edge cases without tracebacks, text order. Fix first: (medium) an old page recorded after a ledger commit leaves the card silent forever, and an uncommitted ledger's digest gets recorded; (medium) any declaration problem, even a missing read_order file, blocks the V-09 tracker-page flow; (low-med) a project in a subdirectory of its git repo uses the git top as root; (low, from V-09) a symlinked tracker dir writes the sidecar outside the project; (low) card wording and a first-record paragraph without --page. 754 OK.

Round 2 rulings: refuse an uncommitted ledger in both modes, and a page last committed before the ledger (git ancestry), with --page-unchanged recorded as the override; block only on an unreadable declaration or a bad plan_page; project root is ledger.parent.parent.parent; refuse a symlinked tracker dir and name it on the card; wording and first-record text fixes. The done text's 'page_digest' corrected to 'the page's digest' (the key is digest).
